{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Prime the caches every Monday
    - cron: 0 1 * * MON

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
          - os: macos-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
          - os: windows-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "5"
            # alcotest-async depends on core_unix, which does not support
            # Windows.
            opam-files: ./alcotest.opam ./alcotest-lwt.opam ./alcotest-mirage.opam
            dune-flags: --only-packages alcotest,alcotest-lwt,alcotest-mirage
          # alcotest-async lower bound
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ocaml-compiler: "4.14"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Set git to use LF
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.eol lf

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set-up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*

      - name: Set-up Binaryen
        if: ${{ matrix.runtest }}
        uses: Aandreba/setup-binaryen@v1.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Set-up OCaml ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}

      - name: Cache opam dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.opam
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-ocaml-${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}-opam-${{ hashFiles('**/*.opam') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-ocaml-${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}-opam-

      - run: opam install ${{ matrix.opam-files || '.' }} --deps-only --with-test

      # The aliases are quoted because PowerShell, the default shell on
      # Windows, reads a bare @name as splatting the variable $name.
      - run: opam exec -- dune build ${{ matrix.dune-flags }} '@install' '@check' '@runtest'

      # The js_of_ocaml backend does not work on Windows yet: absolute paths
      # are mangled and caml_unix_filedescr_of_channel is missing.
      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam install js_of_ocaml-compiler

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- dune build '@runtest-js'

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam install wasm_of_ocaml-compiler

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- dune build @runtest-wasm
        env:
          WASM_OF_OCAML: true

      - if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: opam exec -- sh test/wasm-downstream/run.sh

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set-up OCaml 5
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: "5"

      - name: Lint opam files
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-opam@v3

      - name: Check formatting
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-fmt@v3",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `opam install` to fetch dependencies on every matrix job with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern supports caching dependency downloads in GitHub Actions, with reported modest VM time reduction. Adding an input-keyed cache for the opam directory (keyed by OS, OCaml compiler, and opam file hashes) preserves all build and test coverage while avoiding repeated dependency fetches. No permissions are weakened, no new network access is added, and no required checks are removed.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
